notes.title: Patch 17.1
notes.notes:
[b]Salutations, jolly adventurers![/b]
With the Holidays practically on our doorstep, we thought it’d be great to release one more Patch before the end of the year. This time, it contains some very important fixes, as well as a bunch of great tweaks and additions to make your game as amazing as possible:

[b]FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]The Character Creation screen now allows you to pick your own hair color.[/b] Just click on the Hair Color, and pick your favorite![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/4a802c5ae2df02b5fe637f885806ee664eb955b4.gif[/img]
[list][*] [b]Updated Trading with mobs.[/b] Be sure to check out what they have in stock![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/ffbcb5ea6851ea785d86a87f33397a32e2b6c403.jpg[/img]
[list][*] [b]Recalibrated the way leveling affects player’s stats,[/b] for more sensible leveling experience.
[*] [b]Updated some of the ability descriptions. [/b]They’ll even update automatically as you level up!
[*] [b]Added new sounds for Hammer abilities.[/b] Sounds good to me!
[*] [b]Your weapon strikes are now targeted with your camera[/b] (you can even strike upwards!)
[list][*] [b]Updated some Scythe and Guitar animations for the female character model[/b][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/667cf77958f28c204a80b815f0cb144a48c72a04.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/578807627c8a76b0914e19eda24262b8aa2860b3.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Optimized the way damaging some in-game objects is handled.[/b]
[/list]

[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added some missing translations in the English version.
[*] Fixed the Stone Hands ability using your regular weapon’s attack animation.
[*] The quest that requires you to reach the Faldaren mountains is now completed regardless of how you’ve got there.
[*] Fixed how some souls transformed you into a Pumpkee for no reason.
[*] If you kill the boss in the Abomination world, you can still respawn at your previous location (instead of way back home).[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/50ba2b0df5cfb35e141ea840278040b7ee24882c.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Fixed the way placing grass while in building mode left holes in the terrain.
[*] You can no longer activate objects like Workbenches through walls.
[*] Fixed the lighting effects glitches in some situations. This includes how sometimes NPCs weren’t lit despite standing next to a light source.
[*] Fixed some numbers in GUI displaying with unnecessary dots.
[*] Fixed the way some quest-related entities weren’t highlighted. Highlights also refresh if the player relogins.
[*] Fixed some artifacts in the small birch tree models.
[*] The button in the Soul Altar says “Destroy” instead of “Create”
[/list]

[b]OTHERS:[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized the way the world info is transferred through the Web
[/list]


We hope these updates will make Elteria Adventures even more fun for you! You can discuss this update, as well as give your feedback directly to our development team on [url=https://discord.com/invite/KrxY5RJ]our Discord server[/url]!

[b]And see you soon![/b]

notes.title: Patch 17.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/b5f9efc3bf9b2021da7ff8b247db6dbcb0d98da7.jpg[/img]
[b]Greetings, aspiring adventures![/b]
Today’s major patch finally brings the new Story into Elteria Adventures, with a brand new Chapter 1, as well as some other rebalances, improvements and new goodies for a good measure.

FEATURES:
[list]
[*] [b]Chapter 1 rework.[/b] That’s right, the first Chapter has been finally reworked with a brand new story, challenges and even questing mechanics to boot.
[*] [b]Tutorial Chapter updated.[/b] The Tutorial chapter has gotten a bit better too![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/05eaaf70518d0d4ebe5f789450a6f3b03270d435.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/73ab794ce76d53c4af5b9935bc47e2806cc8f719.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/dbc82934aa55dbbc983a3f1e141491494ab4c043.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/daec0b0a0dca19888c306c3360e16141cf31f9a8.jpg[/img]
[list][*] [b]Added new gloves.[/b] Added several new kinds of gloves to expand your arsenal with.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/de3343cc1e3482d04e7ead83478a7f7f2d02a157.png[/img]
[list][*] [b]Added pedestals.[/b] Pedestals are a new type of objects you can place in your Private Zone to showcase and/or store your best/coolest/rarest pieces of gear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/90fa781b9cc6332da6d0e159f8ea1c8df4ff1024.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Items rehashed.[/b] Yet another massive rehash of item stats, drop, recipes and trading costs.
[*] [b]Abilities updated.[/b] Updated and/or changed a lot of abilities.
[*] [b]Consumables rebalanced.[/b] Unfamiliar and strange? Maybe. Better balanced? We hope so.
[*] [b]Double Jump refreshes after clouds and mushrooms.[/b] Your consumed midair jumps are now replenished after bouncing off a mushroom or a cloud.
[*] [b]Character’s Main Menu preview updated.[/b] Easier to check your gear, easier to pick your hairstyle and tattoos.
[*] [b]Friendly mobs are easier to recognize.[/b] While at full health, the friendly mobs’ HP bar is now hidden.
[*] [b]Improved transparency visuals in GUI.[/b] It should look nicer now.
[/list]

BUGFIXES:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that caused some players to get stuck underground when teleporting home.
[*] Fixed the aiming issues (Demolishers rejoice!).
[*] Fixed the issue that sometimes caused the old version of the world to appear on screen.
[*] Several other minor bugfixes.
[/list]

We hope these updates will make Elteria Adventures even more fun for you! You can discuss this update, as well as give your feedback directly to our development team on [url=https://discord.com/invite/KrxY5RJ]our Discord server[/url]!

[b]And see you soon![/b]

notes.title: Patch 16.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/96445216011f2516d42aeb6249f359db96205860.png[/img]
[b]Greetings, fellow travelers![/b]
The season of reaping is nearing its end. And so, in order to send it off, and start preparing for the end of the year festivities, we’re offering you this patch:

NEW FEATURES:
[list]
[*] [b]Fashionable Warpaint.[/b] Cover your face with imposing, cute or stylish tattoos! Enter the Character Customization screen in order to apply one, and be on the lookout for the future updates to this feature.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/25bb57da2cb29a27ca9ad142f1518e2ddb390483.png[/img]
[*] [b]Joining our (virtual) hands. [/b]The Friendlist is here! Access it via a button above the Chat window, and keep in touch with other players!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/92bf0b6265b3081caa783eeb97f729865a9e2c92.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Gather, Greenhouse Gardeners![/b] Who says you have to pay for indoor greenery? Gather grass, flowers, mushrooms and other plants, and then plant them in your Private Zone via Building mode! And speaking of Gathering…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/c966babe207618db95c2ba5c1eb00de0cd3446c7.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]New and improved Gathering.[/b] Reworked Gathering and Digging. The Gathering marker now highlights EVERY gatherable object in its radius (instead of just the one you’re looking at), as well as tells you what resources (and how many of them) there are in the area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/821033fb45206af4e5352f1a321ef8b965178e6a.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Exactly as dumb as a rock.[/b] Monsters called Stupid Stones have been recently discovered in Elteria. These things are not aggressive, but good luck figuring out how to destroy one!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/e5b4feec816b5d569e07550692963f7425cdd176.jpg[/img]
[/list]

UPDATES:
[list]
[*] [b]Elteria adapts.[/b] Mass update of mob stats and drop tables.
[*] Upholding naming conventions. Updated the names and descriptions of every item in the game to make sure there’s no outdated info.
[*][b] Leaving no stone unturned.[/b] Updated the way most stones are gathered: you’ll only have to Dig for two types of Stones, with the rest being in deposits. .
[*][b] Gems are outrageously easy to get. [/b]Gathering Gems will always give you both whole gems and the shards. Destroying the Gem plants will only leave you with a pittance of shards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/737d8b3f1ace6295caca6701b143b3795edfaff4.gif[/img] 
[*] [b]Music to my ears. [/b]Updated the sounds of playing on a guitar
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/66ab91ada408850d1cf6968fd61368b2c9c84fdd.gif[/img]
[*][b] Take it from the top. [/b]The Character Screen now shows your actual Cooldown Reduction (it can’t get over 40%)
[*][b] Recipe books organized.[/b] The Workbench screen is a bit better optimized to hold a lot of recipes.
[*] [b]Prettier icons. [/b]Updated some of the ability/item icons.
[/list]

BUGFIXES:
[list]
[*] The item passives don’t work if an equipment slot isn’t currently used (like when you switch from one weapon to another, or during Polymorph)
[*] Fixed a lot of small bugs in abilities and buffs
[*] Fixed the way some %-based Healing abilities work (also, Ancient Signet of Blessing isn’t as overpowered as it was before)
[*] Fixed the way some abilities affected the cooldowns of other abilities. Now everything works within the same framework
[*] Fixed the way stats from stacking buffs are displayed
[*] Unified the Summoning mechanics
[*] Removed the popping up message about PvP in the Hub area
[*] Fixed the way item crafting didn’t detect items of higher Item Rarity
[*] Fixed the jumping animation and walking sounds while a Scythe is equipped
[*] Fixed the way lines break in GUI
[*] Fixed the camera vibration/jiggle at some angles.
[/list]

We hope these updates will make[b] Elteria Adventures [/b]even more fun for you! You can discuss this update, as well as give your feedback directly to our development team on [url=https://discord.com/invite/KrxY5RJ]our Discord server[/url]!

[b]And see you soon![/b]

notes.title: Patch 16.7.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/25743616a09643ca3b92bcfd6980ead9eae21d2a.png[/img]
[b]Greetings, enthusiastic crafters![/b]
Today, we’re looking at some tweaks, changes and improvements to crafting and adjacent mechanics to make your arsenal-amassing adventures even smoother:

UPGRADES:
[list]
[*] [b]Who even reads instruction manuals?[/b] Removed the crafting recipes from all crafting requirements AND from the drops. Now you just need the resources to craft any single item in the game. The existing items were also rebalanced a bit.
[*] [b]Underground rock? I Dig it![/b] The Underground Stones now have a chance to drop while you’re tunneling through biomes with your Dig ability (just be sure to upgrade your Universal Tool).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/6d3cad679ea79583a8162313de1d43bd98aa717b.gif[/img]
[*] [b]I can craft it, and I can UNcraft it.[/b] Added the missing items into Soul Altar dismantling tables.
[*] [b]Reforging reforged.[/b] Also added the missing items into the Reforging tables, so you can upgrade all of your gear.
[*] [b]Hey, who turned out the lights?[/b] Removed the ability to turn out the glowing gem blocks outside of your Private Zone. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/ac7d7187a886ae04207c599c9ea3acdf6fef1441.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Esoteric furnishing.[/b] Soul Altars are now craftable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/8f408e962e8f82f2751441fa5e30c1b84720bab5.jpg[/img]
[/list]


BUGFIXES:
[list]
[*] Fixed the way slants and ledges rotate in Building mode.
[*] Added highlights for ore deposits in the tutorial
[*] Fixed the way the Tectonic Fault ability breaks voxels, as well as the object regeneration afterwards.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused some equipment to always be crafted as Regular quality.
[*] Fixed the way abilities behave during re-login while several different types of weapons are equipped.
[*] Fixed the issue with the character being displayed w/o equipment before the equipment has loaded (including during login)
[/list]

OTHERS:
[list]
[*]  Updated the Character Creation/Customization interface.
[*]  Updated the bug reports to include info about outdated video cards.
[/list]

We hope these updates will make Elteria Adventures even more fun for you! You can discuss this update, as well as give your feedback directly to our development team on [url=https://discord.com/invite/KrxY5RJ]our Discord server[/url]!

[b]And see you soon![/b]

notes.title: Patch 16.7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/182acb092d02293a4d71d1435b2251562430c280.png[/img]
[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]
Today’s update contains major gameplay, graphical and interface upgrades to make the game prettier, more fun and more convenient to play. Let’s see what exact features are added into the mix:

[b]GAMEPLAY UPGRADES:[/b]
[list][*] [b]The soul of the blade.[/b] Added the Soul Fusion mechanics. Build (or ask a friend for an access to) an object called Soul Fusion Altar, and you’ll be able to use it to put up to three different souls that you have in your inventory into an item of equipment, giving it secondary passive abilities. This works similarly to Reforge (just without the randomness), and absolutely can be combined with that mechanic AND item Rarity in order to create equipment that is absolutely monstrous in its power.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/8b94394f113c7622d00548c2d5e4c6ce45114cca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/b8d0e91429f9b0622f222303356ac95aeae58054.png[/img]
[*] [b]General Elterian studies. [/b]Added a new 0th chapter that teaches the player the basics of gameplay, as well as showcases the new and improved quest interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/f7dcb2632d58a23cb05d870ff345e5aa1740774a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/e593925fc3d0412f0a61a67411e7c6da10279915.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/5024604b7731ab456941aab2a8f8935c90038abe.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Item balance reevaluation. [/b]Massive rebalance of ALL in-game items, recipes, drop rates and drop tables. 
[*] [b]More clouds.[/b] We just thought that it’d be nice to have more. You know, to jump between the islands.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/9fdd0c76a8dc566401880ae9de089f058d2445cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/d08ee800dada7c2b8c6c25bc5e589ff545c00111.jpg[/img]

[b]GRAPHICAL UPGRADES:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Atmospheric visuals.[/b] New fog, atmosphere and sky effects to show the world of Elteria in its true, beautiful lights
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/3915507be6e6f7d3ae0d985c803040a548c9b05a.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Revamped landmasses.[/b] Revamped a large portion of the world, with lots of new and updated objects and textures to make the world feel even more alive and lush. Combine with the previous feature for maximum effect.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/a5746dc86b3a77511be7c284cab5e3b3336c8fa1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/d1518139bbffa835048d7c26694a24125c588d5b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/e3f64cc16ccbef2d140cfefe511c64a6394ad7ef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/d7d555abad62d334b0ae9560b47c26cf08ec0e45.jpg[/img]

[b]INTERFACE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Game menu updated. [/b]Added Controls rebinding into the Options menu. Also, added the ability to go back to the character selection screen, because some players need that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/cf494f7c3c0233041ad027db6d39a0107b6fc100.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/fe3c459dc79409861cade91420b08b26155676a4.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Character screen relit. [/b]Improved the way the player character’s model is rendered in the character menu so that it stays consistent with the character’s surroundings.
[*] [b]Gathering interface improved.[/b] Improved the gathering interface so that it’s more pleasant and neat. It now also shows the resource you’re gathering, and the highlights are more noticeable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/88e62e8705a0a6da0e9a462e81f6a61199ef96c1.png[/img]
[*] [b]Main menu music re-matched. [/b]Updated the music in the main menu.
[*] [b]Chat text’s volume lowered. [/b]The text in the chat is no longer bolded
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Tectonic Fault’s interaction with the camera rotation
[*] Fixed the bug that caused placed workbenches to be unavailable without re-entering the game
[*] Fixed the boss HP bar being stuck on the screen if the boss is dead or the player left their proximity
[*] Fixed the bug that caused the game to overload the game if it’s minimized and then maximized while in the fullscreen mode
[*] Fixed several crash issues
[/list]

We hope these updates will make Elteria Adventures even more fun for you! You can discuss this update, as well as give your feedback directly to our development team on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.com/invite/KrxY5RJ]our Discord server[/url]!

And see you soon!

notes.title: Patch 16.5.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/93fd53eb2d4fdd8113634ae9c8b11ee1053b3bb2.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]
Today’s patch might not be too big, but it still brings a lot to the table. Let’s see what exactly:

[h3]NEW CONTENT:[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Weapon Usage Unrestricted[/b]. Added weapon rotation: the ability to equip several types of weapons and switch between them during combat with a Mouse Wheel. Changing the camera position now works by [Right Ctrl + Mouse Wheel]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/8585daf7359d1669eb40352bf151bf2d3794a6c4.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Slimy, Wiggly and Slammy[/b]. Added a new mob: Slime Tentacle
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/7259394006c5e426a1bb76a2cb037e3e7cdf4bb9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/9161b59a9c08c6da22eea0ce86d87095421bc20c.png[/img]
[*] [b]A Galactic Stick[/b]. Added [i]Galaxy Staff[/i] — a complete replacement for the starter [i]Magic Staff [/i]that has its own Ability
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/e207f7edef9aac0242e14fceae2a16770f0c1556.png[/img]
[/list]
[h3]UPDATED CONTENT:[/h3][list]
[*] [b]New and improved Crafting![/b] Mass update of item recipes. Go check them out in the crafting menus!
[*] [b]Stop! Star Hammer time![/b] Added a new ability for the [i]Star Hammer[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/b9567b2a00f2f867d27846ab73d7b221c25257bf.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Capable Architect.[/b] Updated several [i]Architect[/i] abilities
[*] [b]Pretty, pretty forests.[/b] Updated Mushroom Forest, Birch Forest and Frosty Mystic Forest textures 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/e04a533ca21dd06cb86496512197a527e1083ab1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/51bc17d577b43090ecf2962313b6d24aa87023b5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/46dcc74555b564c206dbcb4489072da1815c24af.jpg[/img]

[*] Fixed the client freeze due to light source update
[*] Fixed some buffs not being displayed on the player screen (though some weird buffs might’ve began to appear, please tell us if it happens)
[*] Fixed the default position of abilities on the quick access panel
[*] Fixed player clipping through the [i]Architect[/i] platform while falling with high velocity
[*] Fixed armadillo droprates

[/list]

We hope these updates will make [i][b]Elteria Adventures[/b][/i] even more fun for you! You can discuss this update, as well as give your feedback directly to our development team on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/F4khSmK][u][b]Discord server[/b][/u][/url]!

[b]And see you soon![/b]

notes.title: Patch 16.4.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/6c9e6105026f3f1002b4fd94ce10147e68d6e56e.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]
Today’s update is a halfway point to [b]17.0 Megapatch[/b], as some features introduced in [b]16.4[/b] will be expanded upon in [b]17.0[/b], so we’ve got quite a few features to look at. As such, and without further ado, let’s take a look at the changes:

[h3]GAMEPLAY:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Building up expectations (and pillars).[/b] Added two [i]Architect[/i] abilities that unlock on 5th level. Use pillars to defend yourself and counterattack!
[*] [b]Wild encounters.[/b] New mobs for the Wild Area: [i]Ladybug, Lava Tentacle, Lava Slime, Slime Octopus[/i], and new [i]Armadillo [/i]variations. Speaking of, you can purchase a Ladybug Hat from Ladybugs in case you need a portable lighting source.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/d47d209710199cea338a0b237a2cac61f250465c.png[/img]
[*] [b]Now THAT’S a hot take.[/b] Added [i]Lava Slime[/i] boss for the Wild Area. Bring the cold water ro apply directly to those burns!
[*] [b]THE LAMP.[/b] Added a new, glowing variation for the [i]Gem Shard Blocks[/i] (can be used for torches/lighting). Just point at and activate them with the [b][F][/b] button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/e6285436d18553ff13934569ac70b892521fa711.png[/img]
[*] [b]Why do I hear boss music?[/b] Added the Boss Health bar right under the Compass whenever you’re fighting a boss or are just too close to one.
[/list]

[h3]TEST FEATURES:[/h3]
These are test features and alpha versions of the upcoming features in [b]17.0[/b]. Be sure to leave a comment on them to help us in development
[list]
[*] [b]A palette’s worth of bricks and stones.[/b] Brand new [i]Building[/i] interface with palette editor to make construction work that much easier.
[*] [b]Does this make me look cool?[/b] Added a simple customization option for the [i]Character Creation[/i]. For now, the old characters can be edited
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/0d20dbe9b4b1ca3adc6478bb4dbec2228de994b7.png[/img]
[*] [b]Here’s a tip![/b] Added tips for the character screen. Same mechanics will be later used in quests.
[*] [b]Roof over your head, just add water.[/b] After acquiring a [i]Private Zone[/i], you can choose a biome and a preset building to place on it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/9b494dc774e0ff6d08a24d368c1f20309a1b5b9f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/f8e220f09f0e15604a7939e39179c09e59f18aa9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/36fa65984335632bc5b387c10d4bd873f2f4841a.png[/img]
[*] [b]My vision is utterly unclouded![/b] Launcher update that automatically chooses the correct video card to use in the game (in case you have both a regular and an integrated one)
[*][b]There can be only one![/b] Added the Alpha version of the [i]Slime Sumo[/i] game mod. Challenge other players for the title of the bounciest, roundest Pink Slime of all!
[/list]

[h3]UPGRADES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Wild, tall tales.[/b] Updated the quest lines in the [i]Wild Area[/i], added the localizations
[*] [b]‘Tis but a flesh wound![/b] Falling off your Private Island doesn’t kill you anymore, and teleports you back to your island instead.
[*] [b]I’m sorry, I can’t let you do that.[/b]  Added an outline that tells you if you can’t place a block or object somewhere.
[*] [b]Differently looking teleportation devices.[/b] Added new objects that allow you to teleport into your Private Zone and back into the world.
[*] [b]More dangers, more rewards.[/b] Added several mobs and equipment pieces into the world.
[*] Picturesque imagery. Updated several models and textures, as well as the musical theme of Birch Hills.
[/list]

[h3]BALANCE FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Don’t be such a scaredy cat![/b] Reduced the duration of all mobs’ Fear effects
[*] [b]Equipment readjustment.[/b] Rebalanced the stats of a lot of pieces of equipment.
[*] [b][i]Architect’s [/i]anger management.[/b] Architect’s stone hands ability doesn’t activate automatically after receiving/dealing damage anymore.
[/list]

[h3]OTHER:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Officially off-limits.[/b] Fully reworked the restriction system (protected areas, building etc)
[*] [b]Ahhh, so that’s why.[/b] Added more tips on why an action couldn’t be performed.
[*] [b]Exactly up to scale.[/b] Reworked the way the game calculates the size of objects (for example, polymorph will change the physical size of the player, and not just their model)
[*] [b]More hills?[/b] Upgraded the islands’ surface level generation. Yeah, more hills.
[*] [b]Efficiency is the key[/b]. Optimized the memory usage of the server.
[*] [b]I remember everything![/b] Found and eliminated the cause of the game client memory loss after the reconnect
[*] [b]Write it down, write it down![/b] Added the basics for the [b]Promo Code[/b] system. The first [b]Promo Codes[/b] will be distributed as a result of the [i]Monster Design Contest[/i].
[/list]

[h3]INTERFACE:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Login interface that you can actually spend some time in since the game won’t disconnect you for inactivity from there anymore.
[*] Updated the quest marker mechanics, they should be more intuitive and clear now,
[*] New crash report window to make the reporting process easier and faster.
[/list]

[h3]BUGFIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked Architect abilities that place temporary voxels so there are no leftovers in the world afterwards.
[*] Fixed the hitboxes for the [i]Slimes’[/i] bounce abilities so that they scale with the slime’s actual size
[*] Fixed the problem with mobs falling off an island  and hanging in the air beneath the islands.
[*] The jumping is a bit more responsive now.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused the character model disappear after the freezing debuff.
[*] Fixed the game crash after a reconnect if the player is a member of a party.
[*] Fixed the area of voxels destroyed with a stick, sword or fists
[*] Fixed the game crashing after purchasing a boar banner from the Star Shop.
[*] Fixed some building brushes still working in protected areas.
[*] Fixed one of the causes of the freezing of the world rendering.
[*] Fixed the equipment change sometimes causing the character to be shown in their underwear.
[*] Fixed the previews of Workbenches sinking into walls sometimes.
[*] Fixed the game freezing during the fast rendering of the world around the player.
[*] Fixed the item collection quests sometimes not counting collected items.
[*] Fixed the main menu kicking the player out due to the timeout.
[*] Fixed a few client crashes due to inventory issues.
[*] Fixed the incorrect character stats showing with the stone hands activated.
[*] Fixed the bug with the text not showing on Intel HD Graphics 4000
[*] Fixed the textures incorrectly showing on integrated video cards.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused abilities on the quick access panel to change their positions during re-logins
[/list]

We hope these updates will make [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] even more fun for you! You can discuss this update, as well as give your feedback directly to our development team on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/F4khSmK][u][b]Discord server[/b][/u][/url]!

[b]And see you soon![/b]

notes.title: Incoming: Wild and Rare changes to Elteria!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/385f4ac92784d9784eb1a639fd1262943b9ee98c.png[/img]
[b]The Steam Game Festival (June 9th - June 15th)[/b] is just around the corner, and since [b]Elteria Adventures [/b]will be opening its doors for a time-limited [i]Open Alpha[/i], we’re preparing one more update for the occasion. Said update carries some good news, and some bad news: namely, the implementation of two big updates, and a server wipe.[list]
[*] [b][u]Crafting and Rarity system:[/u][/b] With this system in place, every time you craft any piece of armor or a weapon, you’ll have a chance of creating an item of better quality and with the stats to show. With enough patience (or luck), you’ll be able to power up your character in a way that reinforces your playstyle even further than ever before.
[*] [u][b]Wild Area:[/b][/u] a large area accessible since the 3rd character level that features stronger monsters, an ability to build both in and out of your Private Zone (with vast patches of unclaimed land you can make your own base on), and an opportunity to freely battle other players (or cooperate with them, if you’re into that).
[/list]

As for the bad news:[list]
[*] [u][b]Leveling the playfield:[/b][/u] Sadly, these two updates bring huge balancing issues to the table, especially in regards to equipment currently present in the game - which means that, in order to avoid such problems, we’ll have to wipe the alpha servers.  Still, that doesn’t mean that you’ll have to start completely from scratch.
[*] [u][b]Catching up event:[/b][/u] this update will also introduce a time-limited event during which you’ll have to find a certain NPC in order to be granted a batch of powerful items that will allow you to easily catch up to - or even outpace - your previous progress. This means that returning players (as well as savvy new ones) will be able to enter the Wild Area and test out the new Crafting and Rarity systems shortly after this update launches.
[/list]

Once again, we apologize for any and all inconvenience this server wipe might have caused you, and hope that it will result in [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] becoming a much more exciting and satisfying experience for you. Be sure to discuss this, or any other aspect of the game, as well as follow the project news on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/F4khSmK][b]Discord server[/b][/url]!

[b]And see you next time![/b]

notes.title: Incoming: Crafting changes and Teleports!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/33c9ad45c76b05bc6be87b3474225f9be0748d89.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Elteria Adventures team![/b]

Our last update was all about important bug fixes, as well as [i]Quality of Life[/i] changes. Naturally, we’re working on even more ways to make [b]Elteria Adventures[/b] a welcoming and fun world to be in, which is why a number of other exciting Quality of Life changes are already on their way. Today, we’ll tell you about some of them:
The first on today’s list is the [b]Crafting[/b], the changes to which are twofold: introduction of Item [i]Dismantling, improvements to Item Crafting,[/i][list][*][u][b]Break down an item to get resources.[/b][/u] That’s right, you won’t have to tolerate duplicates or items you’re no longer using cluttering up your precious inventory screen. Just put a special workbench in your Home Base, and break down anything you don’t need. Free up that space and get some resources, to either craft something new and exciting, or remake that same item. “Why would I want to do that last one”? Well, that’s because…[*][u][b]A chance to craft an item of improved quality.[/b][/u] What could be better than a Watermelon Staff? A Legendary Watermelon Staff, of course! The updated crafting system will introduce a chance to craft an item of improved quality. There are five overall quality types: Common, Perfect, Legendary, Wild, and Mythic, so whenever you want a collection of different grades of your favorite weapon or armor, or you just want to have an item with the perfect stats, you’ll be able to craft it yourself.
[/list]
Meanwhile, the convenience of  public transportation is finally about to reach the kingdom of [i]Agelon[/i]. Not buses or monorail, of course - it’d be quite hard and costly to build a railway system between the sky islands of [b]Elteria[/b]. We’re talking about something much cheaper and simpler - teleportation!
[list][*] [b][u]Beam me up, Qubit![/u] [/b]The special NPCs called Qubits are going to appear in different parts of Elteria, allowing for an instant transit between themselves. Thanks to this, your daily commute between different parts of Agelon will become much faster and easier - and to think it only took some mild breaks of space-time continuum to achieve!
[/list]
So collect all the necessary crafting components, and get ready to zap around [b]Elteria[/b] brandishing your epic loot at the speed of light once these updates reach the alpha servers!. And if you want to be instantly notified of such an update and any other[b] Elteria Adventures[/b] news, as well as discuss the game with other players and us, you can do so on our [url=https://discord.gg/hSVgG8B][b]Discord server[/b][/url].

[b]And see you next time![/b]

notes.title: Story Chapters and Gameplay Changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33209929/fdd8ccc228adb538337307b83251da8a1f1385bf.png[/img]

If you want to discuss the update, head over to our [b][url=https://discord.gg/u2AVU5K]Discord[/url][/b] server!

[i][b]Greetings from the Elteria team![/b][/i]
Today, as we’re releasing the new, big and shiny 0.15 mega update, you’ll find that the game had indeed changed quite a bit.

Today’s update introduces the [b]Hub[/b] and the [b]Chapters[/b]. The [b]Hub[/b] is located in the castle of [i]Agelon[/i], which serves as the capital city of the human civilization on Elteria. As a newly arrived hero, you’ll help the citizens of [i]Agelon[/i], as well as the people of its many satellite towns. In the first two released story [b]Chapters[/b], you’ll investigate the current happenings of the relatively peaceful town of [i]Faldaren[/i] in Birch Hills, as well as learn about some of the cutest denizens of [b]Elteria[/b] in the mystical and wondrous town of [i]Orzan[/i] located in the [i]Tentacle Grove[/i]. Maybe you’ll even learn some of the deeply rooted secrets of the strange yet beautiful world of [b]Elteria[/b] in this journey of yours.

In order to help you experience this adventure to its fullest, we have also made some changes to the gameplay.

[list]
[*] No more pointless grind to level up your [i]Calling[/i]. Every [i]Calling[/i] has a handful of balanced (or even re-balanced!) abilities that scale with the power of your equipment, and you’re able to change your calling at almost any given time. In one of the future updates, you might find a way to acquire even more [i]Calling[/i] abilities for every [i]Calling[/i] in your arsenal.

[*] Treasure your bridges as they’re hard to replace. In order to ensure the smooth story experience, as well as to prevent any griefing, we have limited the ability to build structures to the players’ own Private Zones - though some free-to-build areas might also appear in some of the future updates.

[*] There’s a paper shortage in the local store. For the time being, the quest info is limited to the quest tracking on the playing screen. It’ll take us some time to implement a fully functional quest log, which will come in one of the future updates.
[/list]

Currently, there are the biomes of two [b]Chapters[/b] and the [b]Hub[/b] area available for you to explore. We’re still doing some maintenance on the second [b]Chapter[/b] (so there might be some bugs), and there’s even more content being on its way. Become the true hero of [i]Agelon[/i] - and stay tuned for the details of the next incoming update!

[i][b]See you next time![/b][/i]

notes.title: Development Update 22 september 2018
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Elteria Team here.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33209929/16feef2717a54a2991c520ca045fb690239ab10c.png[/img]
[h1]Voxel updates speedup[/h1]
This week has been marked by huge technological breakthrough made by our brilliant programmers: they have been able to decrease landscape update delay several times! Fighter's ability Tectonic Fault now breaks voxels with only 30ms delay! It used to be about 500ms. This has been done with some incredible coding magic. For those who interested: they basically redraw patch on affected part of the screen in the shader, while the landscape is slowly updated in the background. 
[url=https://twitter.com/eirenliel/status/1038378068501585920]
Here[/url] is a short video.

[h1]The Glove [/h1]
The Glove, we changed it's name too many times. It's the primary tool in the game. Now it's called Neophyte Glove. Maybe we change its name again. Instead of making a dozen different tool type items, we decided to upgrade it incrementally. It is not used in any battle capacity, so it's not about balance, it's about player convenience! Currently, we laid down roughly 15 upgrades to it, at least 9 of them will have a visual distinction. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33209929/af0d938f41b4d35515a308fd4693d115443adc55.png[/img]
One of the early upgrades will give the ability to create personal space, an Elteria Home heart. This will instantly create a Home Field - a special zone, in which player resurrects after death and in which they can start building their first home. Only one Home Field per character is allowed. 
Of course, the player can rebuild this area how they want, but by default, it will be a premade hut. The following pictures are concepts of what there will be located:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33209929/5c35bba1cd9c14b56a0ccf81cb63791940310235.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33209929/fb66d840a03ab4f7601555a295fd5bf6ff4d5875.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33209929/2c0009c538465093a28fb987f10cc840fe1986a1.jpg[/img]
Regarding what this is... let it stay a mystery for some time!

[h1]Music[/h1]
You probably have not noticed yet, but the sound part of the game was lagging behind. We have been gaining on that very much lately. We started a partnership with an awesome sound design team, and while our code team is building an improved sound engine for the game, we had received two primary music themes!
Elteria Adventures - The Main Theme:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_FadUDyk5cYSm5kLw4Ltih2zM6lIkk1X/view
Elteria Adventures - Wooden Biome Theme

And lastly, look at this cutie! The plum octopus. Yes, of course, It WILL try to kill you!
